notes.13: Aakriti har baar ghadi ki disha me 90° ghoomti hai aur uska rang baari-baari se badalta hai (kaala, safed, kaala ...). Isliye chautha chitra (D) hoga.
notes.14: Har agle chitra me usi disha me ek nayi rekha judti hai (1, 2, 3 ...). Chauthe chitra me 4 rekhayen hongi aur nayi rekha pichhli ke theek baad aayegi — (C).
notes.15: Har agle chitra me aakriti ghadi ki ulti disha me 135° ghoomti hai. Teesre chitra ko utna hi aur ghumane par (D) milta hai.
notes.16: Kaala bindu har baar ghadi ki disha me 1 sthan aage badhta hai aur andar ka tribhuj ghadi ki ulti disha me 1 sthan. Dono ko ek-ek kadam aur badhane par (A) milta hai.
notes.17: Pehle jode me kaale hisse safed aur safed hisse kaale ho gaye hain. Teesri aakriti me yahi badlav karne par (D) milta hai.
notes.18: Pehle jode me doosri aakriti pehli ko lekar ghadi ki ulti disha me 90° ghumaya gaya hai. Teesri aakriti ke saath wahi karne par (C) milta hai.
notes.19: Pehle jode me doosri aakriti pehli ko lekar ghadi ki disha me 90° ghumaya gaya hai. Teesri aakriti ke saath wahi karne par (C) milta hai.
